notes.title: Cosmic Cosmonaut Demo v0.1.6
notes.content:
Hello Cosmonauts! I come with the patch notes of the Cosmic Cosmonaut Demo version 0.1.6, which should be rolling out to you today.

[list]
[*]AI ships now react to being hit by the player. Watch the paint!
[*] Added Titan to the Sol system.
   - Also has a new curiosity to find!
[*] Added an indicator for recently scanned planets, letting you knew when they can not be scanned for now, or when you found the curiosity there.
[*] Added better visual indicators for selecting and browsing your cosmonaut in Profile Selection.
[/list]

Happy exploring!

Best regards,

Roland,

A.k.a. 
The Quirky Dutchman

notes.title: Cosmic Cosmonaut Demo v0.1.5
notes.content:
Hello Cosmonauts!

The Cosmic cosmonaut Demo, version 0.1.5 is out now, with a couple of smaller fixes:
  
[list]
[*] The use of Escape key is now more intuitive. It will close more of the currently active window or screen, making navigation quicker and more consistent.
[*] Minor adjustment to Ruroli's (purple alien) dialogue.
[*] The layout for buy and sell rows in the trade interface has been slightly adjusted for better clarity.
[/list]
Best regards,

Roland 
A.k.a. 
The Quirky Dutchman

notes.title: Cosmic Cosmonaut Demo v0.1.3
notes.content:
Hello Cosmonauts!
I bring a new update, in the form of [b]version 0.1.3[/b].

New Content
[list]
[*] [b]Diamond Rain:[/b] Added a "Diamond Rain" curiosity to Neptune.
[*] [b]Alien Translation:[/b] There's now a short new section before meeting the purple alien, showing the player that there is now translation being done by the onboard computer.
[/list]

Improvements & Quality of Life
[list]
[*] [b]Radar:[/b] Ships are now displayed with different colors on the radar for better identification.
[*] [b]Dialogue:[/b] Updated dialogue scenes to now show character names. The text and name panels have also been improved.
[*] [b]UI:[/b] The general text display in the GUI has been slightly improved.
[*] [b]Gameplay:[/b] The in-game passing of days has been slowed down by 4 times. Rescanning is now doable 2 days after each scan.
[*] [b]Tutorial:[/b] The initial battle description has been adjusted to make the real-time battle system more clear.
[*] [b]Dialogue Icon:[/b] The voice enable/mute button has a better icon.
[*] [b]Visual:[/b] The sun/stars now have a far more fluid way of rendering, with increased FPS.
[*] [b]Intro:[/b] Added some clarity related to the steps needed to create your own profile.
[/list]

Performance
[list]
[*] [b]VRAM Usage:[/b] Improved a few aspects of the game, resulting in a 10-15% VRAM usage reduction.
[/list]

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Laika would not be set as a quest target after intercepting the unknown object.
[*] Fixed a visual bug where a Pactarian character had the wrong background.
[*] Fixed several typos related to Director Savarin.
[/list]

I've heard a lot of mentions of the load/save system not working as intended. Know that I'm currently diving into this and will report back once there have been improvements there. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Demo v0.1.2
notes.content:
Hello Cosmonauts! I come with bugfixes in the form of the Cosmic Cosmonaut Demo version 0.1.2.

Fixed:

[list]
[*]     Addressed an issue causing odd initial game window placement.
[*]     Fixed an issue where no quest arrow would direct the player back to the station after destroying satellites (quest step).
[*]     Addressed some Mars voice lines not matching the character or causing text to skip.
[*]     Fixed missing selection outline for Laika Station.
[*]     Corrected typo in Laika Station commander dialogue ("you.s" to "you.").
[*]     Corrected typos in Rikhter R23 weapon description ("acual" to "actual", "pobably" to "probably")
[/list]

Improved:

[list]
[*]     Sol target practice quest now correctly sets its tracking target while in progress.
[*] 	Scanning Mars before receiving the "Scan Mars" mission from Nikolai will now offer option to use existing scan data for quest instead of requiring a re-scan.
[*] 	Mars now has its details implemented.
[*]     Mercury now has its details implemented.
[/list]

As always, Steam should eventually automatically download this new version. You can restart Steam to make this happen immediately, or verify the game files.

Thank you for trying the demo!

notes.title: Devlog 2: Battles
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome back Cosmonaut![/h1]

Although quite a few elements of the gameplay in Cosmic Cosmonaut are not related to combat, there will be a time where you will be required to defend your fleet in fierce cosmic battles. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065764/439a24078f9143f130561c458e067128f3dafef0.png[/img]

As fleet commander, you command a fleet of up to 9 ships, carefully choosing your composition to maximize your strength. Your opponents will also have a fleet of up to 9 ships, ready to challenge you at every turn. These battles are in real time - making sure that there's always action on the screen at any time.

[h2][h2]Targeting[/h2][/h2]

You can take control of your ships' attacks, either by letting them automatically target enemies or by manually focusing fire on specific vessels. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065764/65579133dda2e351c005deac7758c992912125b0.gif[/img]

[h2]Special Abilities[/h2]

You can also use powerful special abilities that can turn the tide of battle, for which you can purchase ammunition to replenish these abilities and maintain a tactical advantage. As you progress through the game and complete challenges, you'll unlock new and exciting ones.


In the demo, you'll have access to one special ability. The nuclear missile. This devastating first ability deal massive damage to a single target, with a satisfying kaboom.

As a special treat, here's a quick preview of the nuclear missile:

[previewyoutube=kQ7pFCy9m48;full][/previewyoutube]

Hopefully you enjoyed this quick dive into the battle system, see you in the next update!

notes.title: Devlog 1: Progress
notes.content:
Hey everyone! It's been a little while since I last checked in, so I wanted to give you a quick update on what I've been working on.

[h2]Quests[/h2]

There's been made significant progress on the quest system, which will add more depth and direction to the gameplay. Quests for example can now have starting and ending conditions, and can respond to events in game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065764/f7bd50a2b4f001f2d6a131419baacf711b269d0e.png[/img]

There's also a quest target indicator next to your ship, so you never lose the way. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065764/57d1919d7e5b19b170a976831d1f374414c58126.gif[/img]

For more experienced players, this indicator can be turned off!

[h2]Trade[/h2]

I've also been refining the trading mechanic, making it more dynamic and rewarding - as each trading port has it's own prices and available goods. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065764/d4bf118657b1618338237ea326f2108e4eda69da.png[/img]

To expand the universe, I've added more planetary systems for you to explore, each with its own unique characteristics and things to explore. 

My primary goal right now is to get a demo ready for you all to try. This will give you a taste of what the game has to offer and help me gather valuable feedback. All upcoming devlogs will focus on this process, so stay tuned for more updates!

[i]p.s. If you'd like to know what motivated me to pick the theme and setting for the game - Check the previous update, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2985570/view/6233628070469225538?l=english]here[/url].[/i]
